016package com.edbplus.db.web.api;
017
018import lombok.Data;
019
020import java.io.Serializable;
021import java.util.List;
022
023/**
024 * @program: coreframework-parent
025 * @description: API结果数据类
026 * @author: 杨志佳
027 * @create: 2021-01-12 11:27
028 **/
029@Data
030public class ApiResult<T> implements Serializable {
031
032    //代码
033    private Integer code;
034    //消息
035    private String msg;
036    //对象
037    private T main;
038
039    //总条数--分页条件此参数有值
040    private Integer count;
041
042    public static <T>  ApiResult<T> successMessage(String msg) {
043        ApiResult<T> ret = ApiResult.success();
044        ret.setMsg(msg);
045        return ret;
046    }
047
048    public static <T> ApiResult<T> success() {
049        ApiResult<T> ret = new ApiResult<T>();
050        ret.setCode(ApiReturnCode.SUCCESS.getCode());
051        ret.setMsg(ApiReturnCode.SUCCESS.getDesc());
052        return ret;
053    }
054
055    public static <T> ApiResult<T> success(T data) {
056        ApiResult<T> ret = ApiResult.success();
057        ret.setMain(data);
058        ret.setCount(1);
059        return ret;
060    }
061
062
063
064    public static <T> ApiResult<T> fail() {
065        ApiResult<T> ret = new ApiResult<T>();
066        ret.setCode(ApiReturnCode.FAIL.getCode());
067        ret.setMsg(ApiReturnCode.FAIL.getDesc());
068        return ret;
069    }
070
071
072    public static <T>  ApiResult<T> failMessage(String msg) {
073        ApiResult<T> ret = ApiResult.fail();
074        ret.setMsg(msg);
075        return ret;
076    }
077
078
079}
